title: ICON 1.5 — Class: Mendicant
description: Blessing tokens, Bless, Diaga and combos: the Mendicant's class tools.

steps.title: Playing a Mendicant
steps.content:
Mendicants heal and protect: Diaga cures, Bless hands out blessing tokens, and Succor lets you Rescue an ally up to range 4 (p.172).
This tour opens the sheet of a Mendicant you own and shows the class tools.

steps.title: Blessing tokens
steps.content: The blessing tokens you hold. A character can spend one when making a save for +1 boon; each Mendicant job also has its own ways to spend them. They don't belong to anyone: a blessing from any Mendicant works for you. All are discarded at the end of combat, and the sheet empties the counter by itself (p.172).

steps.title: Bless
steps.content: Bless (1 action, range 4) is on the class trait. It opens a window to pick who gets the blessing (targeted characters first, then the party) and gives them a Blessed charge. When a blessed character rolls a save, the save window offers to spend a charge for +1 boon.

steps.title: Diaga and Cure
steps.content: A cured character gains 4 vigor (a vigor surge if bloodied), then saves against each of their statuses (p.85). Diaga's card has a Cure button: target the ally and click it, and the system gives the vigor and rolls the saves, asking about Blessed charges. Recover on the sheet does the same for yourself.

steps.title: Combos
steps.content: Many Mendicant abilities are combos. The COMBO checkbox is your combo token: posting the base version with Show in Chat gives it, the next combo ability spends it, all by itself (p.103).

steps.title: Sealer: the mantra die
steps.content: Sealers only. Godly Smite's mantra is a power die on its trait: the sheet sets it out at the start of combat and ticks it up every round. Use − / + and roll it from here. When you or an ally makes an attack roll, the attack card shows a Godly Smite +N button: it spends the interrupt, adds the die to the total (the card shows the new result) and posts a card with a button for the damage the target takes again.

steps.title: Harvester: thralls, plants, Mark of Tsumi
steps.content: Harvesters only. Thralls come from the chip of the ability that summons them (six at most). At the start of your turn a card asks you to move them, then Strike and become plants deals their 1 piercing damage to the adjacent foe you pick and turns each one into a plant. A foe entering or leaving a plant is asked about the dangerous terrain damage; an ally entering it can pick its blessing up, and the plant goes. With Mark of Tsumi a card at the end of your turn has the damage to your marked foes and the blessing; with Gardener of Kin your marks stack two on one character.

steps.title: That's the Mendicant
steps.content: Playing a Seer? Its card deck has its own tour: The Seer's Great Wheel, in Settings → Tours.
